name: Bethanechol
aliases: 2-carbamoyloxypropyl-trimethylazanium, amidopropyldimethylbetaine, Amidopropyldimethylbetaine, carbamoyl-beta-methylcholine, Carbamoyl-beta-methylcholine, carbamoyl-β-methylcholine, carbamyl-beta-methylcholine, Carbamyl-beta-methylcholine
summary: Bethanechol is a parasympathomimetic choline carbamate that selectively stimulates muscarinic receptors without any effect on nicotinic receptors. Unlike acetylcholine, bethanechol is not hydrolyzed by cholinesterase and will therefore have a long duration of action. Bethanechol is sold under the brand names Duvoid (Roberts), Myotonachol (Glenwood), Urecholine (Merck Frosst), and Urocarb (Hamilton).
